decennial.boss.evil_100.name: Lucifero
decennial.boss.evil_100.title: Supreme Devil of Gravity, Ruler of the Underworld Root
decennial.boss.evil_100.lore: Lucifero sits on the Root Throne. The Tree is his body, the Underworld his weight, and every gate you passed was a door he held open for you. The last Supreme Devil is the end of the road.
decennial.boss.evil_099.name: Zagred
decennial.boss.evil_099.title: Supreme Devil of the Word
decennial.boss.evil_099.lore: Zagred has only to say a thing for it to be true, and the roots of the Tree listen better than anyone. The second Supreme Devil speaks softly.
decennial.boss.evil_098.name: Megicula
decennial.boss.evil_098.title: Supreme Devil of Curses
decennial.boss.evil_098.lore: Megicula wears the curses of ten thousand years as a gown. The first of the three Supreme Devils receives the party at the root of the Tree, and is gracious about it.
decennial.boss.evil_097.name: Ovrazel
decennial.boss.evil_097.title: the Threshold Devil, Warden of the Seventh Gate
decennial.boss.evil_097.lore: Ovrazel is the last door before the throne, and the only devil of the Root that was never given a name by men. She has kept the seventh gate since before there was a tree.
decennial.boss.evil_096.name: Vecna
decennial.boss.evil_096.title: The Whispered One
decennial.boss.evil_096.lore: The Whispered One lost a hand and an eye and gained the Hand and the Eye of Vecna. He is a god of secrets, and he knows yours.
decennial.boss.evil_095.name: Orcanth the Bell That Tolls Once
decennial.boss.evil_095.title: Doom Herald of the Bell Below
decennial.boss.evil_095.lore: Orcanth brings news from the end of the world. It is a short announcement, and everyone in the Bell Below has heard it.
decennial.boss.evil_094.name: Asmodeus
decennial.boss.evil_094.title: Lord of the Nine Hells
decennial.boss.evil_094.lore: Lord of the Nine Hells, Asmodeus has never broken a contract, and has never needed to. The throne he sits on was made from the last person who argued.
decennial.boss.evil_093.name: Kaldrith, Keeper of the Ninth Hoard
decennial.boss.evil_093.title: Dracolich of the Gold-Choked Vault
decennial.boss.evil_093.lore: Kaldrith died on its hoard and refused to leave it. The hoard of the Gold-Choked Vault has kept the dragon, and the dragon has kept the hoard.
decennial.boss.evil_092.name: Malgrave, Signatory of Ruin
decennial.boss.evil_092.title: Archdevil of the Throne of Ash
decennial.boss.evil_092.lore: Malgrave never lies; that is the horror of it. Every word he gave in the Throne of Ash is binding, and every one is kept to the letter.
decennial.boss.evil_091.name: Tiamat
decennial.boss.evil_091.title: The Five-Headed Queen
decennial.boss.evil_091.lore: Five heads, five breaths, and one craving. Tiamat the Five-Headed Queen counts the hoard of her cavern in the lives of heroes.
decennial.boss.evil_090.name: Balthazek, Maw of the Rift
decennial.boss.evil_090.title: Abyssal Horror of the Hollow Ocean
decennial.boss.evil_090.lore: Balthazek is older than the dungeon, and the dungeon is older than anyone who walks it. the Hollow Ocean is only where it chose to rise.
decennial.boss.evil_089.name: Charnel the Unwinding
decennial.boss.evil_089.title: Clockwork Tyrant of the Gear-Choked Deep
decennial.boss.evil_089.lore: Charnel counts the seconds until you stop. It has been counting since before the vault of the Gear-Choked Deep had a roof.
decennial.boss.evil_088.name: Acererak
decennial.boss.evil_088.title: The Devourer of the Tomb
decennial.boss.evil_088.lore: A lich who built a tomb to feed on the souls of those who tried to rob it. Acererak has read every page of your life, and has not found it interesting.
decennial.boss.evil_087.name: Lamentis, Tyrant of Ten Gazes
decennial.boss.evil_087.title: Eye Tyrant of the Starless Cell
decennial.boss.evil_087.lore: Lamentis has never blinked. Nothing in the Starless Cell has been unobserved since the day it woke.
decennial.boss.evil_086.name: Kryptoth, Who Eats the Constellations
decennial.boss.evil_086.title: Star-Eater of the Starless Dome
decennial.boss.evil_086.lore: The stars over the Starless Dome go out one by one. Kryptoth is not hurrying; it has all night, and all the nights after.
decennial.boss.evil_085.name: Liebe
decennial.boss.evil_085.title: Devil of the Null, Warden of the Sixth Gate
decennial.boss.evil_085.lore: Liebe does not fight magic. She does not allow it. At the sixth gate, every spell that reaches her is a thing that never happened.
decennial.boss.evil_084.name: Ilvarune, Prince of the Howling Rift
decennial.boss.evil_084.title: Demon Lord of the Ember Warrens
decennial.boss.evil_084.lore: Ilvarune does not scheme. Schemes are for devils. He walks out of the Ember Warrens and everything in front of him is on fire.
decennial.boss.evil_083.name: Embergaunt, Eater of Boats
decennial.boss.evil_083.title: Rot Wyrm of the Fen of Teeth
decennial.boss.evil_083.lore: Embergaunt sleeps in the black water of the Fen of Teeth with only her eyes above the mud. They never close.
decennial.boss.evil_082.name: Orcus
decennial.boss.evil_082.title: Demon Prince of Undeath
decennial.boss.evil_082.lore: The Demon Prince of Undeath wields a wand that unmakes the living. Orcus keeps the graveyard because he likes the company of what is left.
decennial.boss.evil_081.name: Krampus, Who Reaps in Silence
decennial.boss.evil_081.title: Shadow Reaper of the Pale Harvest
decennial.boss.evil_081.lore: He does not take pleasure in it. He does not take anything else either.
decennial.boss.evil_080.name: Plaguemar the Ticking Sovereign
decennial.boss.evil_080.title: Clockwork Tyrant of the Great Escapement
decennial.boss.evil_080.lore: Plaguemar was built to enforce a law that no longer exists, and enforces it very thoroughly.
decennial.boss.evil_079.name: Dolmaris, Swallower of Lanterns
decennial.boss.evil_079.title: Star-Eater of the Eclipse Deep
decennial.boss.evil_079.lore: Dolmaris swallowed a constellation for every name you have forgotten.
decennial.boss.evil_078.name: Demogorgon
decennial.boss.evil_078.title: Prince of Demons
decennial.boss.evil_078.lore: The Prince of Demons has two heads that do not agree with each other, and a madness that agrees with everything. The rift opens wherever he looks.
decennial.boss.evil_077.name: Dhurnak the Mire Sovereign
decennial.boss.evil_077.title: Rot Wyrm of the Drowned Aerie
decennial.boss.evil_077.lore: The air around Dhurnak is acid and rain. the Drowned Aerie is the only place in the world where it is always raining.
decennial.boss.evil_076.name: Nightbriar the Bell That Tolls Once
decennial.boss.evil_076.title: Doom Herald of the Last Gate
decennial.boss.evil_076.lore: Messengers in the dungeon fear Nightbriar: he is the one they work for.
decennial.boss.evil_075.name: Mortuane the Slow Wave
decennial.boss.evil_075.title: Drowned Leviathan of the Tide-Temple
decennial.boss.evil_075.lore: Drowned priests still chant in the Tide-Temple. Mortuane is the god they pray to, and it answers.
decennial.boss.evil_074.name: Zariel
decennial.boss.evil_074.title: Archduchess of Avernus
decennial.boss.evil_074.lore: Once an angel, now an archduchess of the Nine Hells in burnt plate and a broken halo. Zariel keeps her war going, and you are on the front line.
decennial.boss.evil_073.name: Ebonwyr the Smiling Debt
decennial.boss.evil_073.title: Archdevil of the Ledger-Halls
decennial.boss.evil_073.lore: Ebonwyr will offer you a bargain. Count your fingers afterwards, and count the clauses you did not read.
decennial.boss.evil_072.name: Zhulgrim, Tyrant of Ten Gazes
decennial.boss.evil_072.title: Eye Tyrant of the Hall of Ten Windows
decennial.boss.evil_072.lore: the Hall of Ten Windows is not a lair. It is a lens, and Zhulgrim is the thing that looks through.
decennial.boss.evil_071.name: Beelzebub
decennial.boss.evil_071.title: Devil of Space, Warden of the Fifth Gate
decennial.boss.evil_071.lore: Beelzebub folds the roots of the fifth level until no two of them are where they were. Nothing here is where you left it, including you.
decennial.boss.evil_070.name: Hexenmoor, Craving Made Flesh
decennial.boss.evil_070.title: Demon Lord of the Teeth of the Abyss
decennial.boss.evil_070.lore: Armies once held the gate of the Teeth of the Abyss. Hexenmoor wore their banners as a cape for a century.
decennial.boss.evil_069.name: Yzmora, Who Rose From Below
decennial.boss.evil_069.title: Abyssal Horror of the Starless Abyss
decennial.boss.evil_069.lore: the Starless Abyss is not deep. It is merely the part of Yzmora that has come up so far.
decennial.boss.evil_068.name: The Kraken
decennial.boss.evil_068.title: Terror of the Black Tide
decennial.boss.evil_068.lore: The Kraken has eaten the sea beneath the Sunken Temple and begun on what stands above it. Its eight arms are the only part of it you will ever see move.
decennial.boss.evil_067.name: Shadowmere, Who Remembers You
decennial.boss.evil_067.title: Mind Flayer of the Thought-Cistern
decennial.boss.evil_067.lore: If you hear a hum in the Thought-Cistern, it is already too late. If you hear your own voice, it is later still.
decennial.boss.evil_066.name: The Dracolich
decennial.boss.evil_066.title: Wyrm of the Frozen Crypt
decennial.boss.evil_066.lore: A dragon that died frozen and was not permitted to stay dead. The Dracolich guards the Frozen Crypt with a breath that has outlasted its owner's name.
decennial.boss.evil_065.name: Tenebris, Wyrm Beyond Death
decennial.boss.evil_065.title: Dracolich of the Frostfell Cairn
decennial.boss.evil_065.lore: The wyrm of the Frostfell Cairn lost its flesh long ago. It lost nothing else.
decennial.boss.evil_064.name: Zombara the Face Behind
decennial.boss.evil_064.title: Mirror Duke of the Silvered Gallery
decennial.boss.evil_064.lore: Strike a reflection of Zombara and the real one flinches. Nobody has ever been able to tell which is which.
decennial.boss.evil_063.name: Lolth
decennial.boss.evil_063.title: Queen of the Demonweb
decennial.boss.evil_063.lore: Lolth is the Queen of the Demonweb: half dark elf, half spider, and entirely patient. She makes promises in silk, and silk keeps.
decennial.boss.evil_062.name: Reaverne the Black Omen
decennial.boss.evil_062.title: Doom Herald of the Spire of Endings
decennial.boss.evil_062.lore: He blows a horn, once. the Spire of Endings has not been the same since, and neither has the sky above it.
decennial.boss.evil_061.name: Revenara the Last Shadow
decennial.boss.evil_061.title: Shadow Reaper of the Quiet Acre
decennial.boss.evil_061.lore: Nobody has ever seen Revenara walk. He is simply there, and then so is the scythe.
decennial.boss.evil_060.name: Vilemoor the Nameless Depth
decennial.boss.evil_060.title: Abyssal Horror of the Rift Below
decennial.boss.evil_060.lore: The light of the rift is the only light Vilemoor has ever seen. It is not impressed.
decennial.boss.evil_059.name: Karnavar of the Black Water
decennial.boss.evil_059.title: Rot Wyrm of the Reed Throne
decennial.boss.evil_059.lore: Whole villages sank into the Reed Throne so that Karnavar could rest. She remembers them as a pleasant meal.
decennial.boss.evil_058.name: Zaelithar, Master of the Final Hour
decennial.boss.evil_058.title: Clockwork Tyrant of the Brass Cathedral
decennial.boss.evil_058.lore: The great clock of the Brass Cathedral is not a clock. It is a machine for deciding how long you have left.
decennial.boss.evil_057.name: Astaroth
decennial.boss.evil_057.title: Devil of Time, Warden of the Fourth Gate
decennial.boss.evil_057.lore: Astaroth is always a moment ahead of you. By the time the roots of the fourth gate have closed on a hero, he has already gone on to the next.
decennial.boss.evil_056.name: Gorlach the Craving Beneath
decennial.boss.evil_056.title: Drowned Leviathan of the Flooded Vault
decennial.boss.evil_056.lore: The tide that rises in the Flooded Vault is not water. It is Gorlach, breathing.
decennial.boss.evil_055.name: Vorgath of the Silken Chains
decennial.boss.evil_055.title: Sin Duchess of the Hall of Wanting
decennial.boss.evil_055.lore: At the masque of the Hall of Wanting everyone wears a face but Vorgath. She wears yours.
decennial.boss.evil_054.name: Gehennis, Who Remembers You
decennial.boss.evil_054.title: Mind Flayer of the Cerebral Deep
decennial.boss.evil_054.lore: The Hive of the Cerebral Deep grows one mind wider with every traveller. Gehennis is the part that does the choosing.
decennial.boss.evil_053.name: Vashmorr, Tyrant of Ten Gazes
decennial.boss.evil_053.title: Eye Tyrant of the Gazing Deep
decennial.boss.evil_053.lore: Each eye of Vashmorr sees a different future of you. He prefers the one in which you are already dead.
decennial.boss.evil_052.name: The Elder Brain
decennial.boss.evil_052.title: Mind of the Illithid Colony
decennial.boss.evil_052.lore: The Elder Brain floats in its jar of green ooze and thinks. Everything in the colony is a thought of it, and most of the thoughts are about you.
decennial.boss.evil_051.name: Wrathgar the Unspoken Hymn
decennial.boss.evil_051.title: Cult Prophet of the Cellar Congregation
decennial.boss.evil_051.lore: The cult of the Cellar Congregation numbers thirteen. Wrathgar is the one who is not afraid.
decennial.boss.evil_050.name: Abaddar, Preacher of the Pit
decennial.boss.evil_050.title: Sanguine Prophet of the Rite Below
decennial.boss.evil_050.lore: The congregation of the Rite Below no longer remembers a time before Abaddar; they remember only the sermons, and the knife.
decennial.boss.evil_049.name: Gallowmere, Wyrm Beyond Death
decennial.boss.evil_049.title: Dracolich of the Ashen Aerie
decennial.boss.evil_049.lore: Every coin in the Ashen Aerie was paid for in lives. Gallowmere counts them nightly, one rib at a time.
decennial.boss.evil_048.name: Tartarus, Smith of Endings
decennial.boss.evil_048.title: Forge Tyrant of the Slagworks
decennial.boss.evil_048.lore: The hammer of Tartarus has rung on the anvil of the Slagworks for so long the mountain hums to it.
decennial.boss.evil_047.name: The Lich King
decennial.boss.evil_047.title: Lord of the Ossuary
decennial.boss.evil_047.lore: He wears the frost-steel of a king who sold his people for one more winter. The Lich King commands the dead of the Ossuary and a runeblade that remembers each of them.
decennial.boss.evil_046.name: Drakmor, Prince of the Howling Rift
decennial.boss.evil_046.title: Demon Lord of the Slaughter-Deep
decennial.boss.evil_046.lore: The rift at the Slaughter-Deep opened the day Drakmor woke, and it has never quite closed since.
decennial.boss.evil_045.name: Umbrakh, Who Eats the Constellations
decennial.boss.evil_045.title: Star-Eater of the Dying Sky
decennial.boss.evil_045.lore: Astronomers built the Dying Sky to watch the sky. They did not think to ask what watched back.
decennial.boss.evil_044.name: Quartzmaw the Contract-Keeper
decennial.boss.evil_044.title: Archdevil of the Court of Embers
decennial.boss.evil_044.lore: A devil of the Court of Embers, Quartzmaw collects souls the way a banker collects interest: patiently, in full, and with a smile.
decennial.boss.evil_043.name: Dusksworn of the Thousand Veils
decennial.boss.evil_043.title: Wraith King of the Veiled Barrow
decennial.boss.evil_043.lore: The dead of the Veiled Barrow kneel to Dusksworn, and the living who hear them kneel too, if they stay long enough.
decennial.boss.evil_042.name: Lilith
decennial.boss.evil_042.title: Devil of Ice, Warden of the Third Gate
decennial.boss.evil_042.lore: Lilith froze the sap of the third level into black glass, and walks on it. The roots here are brittle, and the silence is hers.
decennial.boss.evil_041.name: Nemain the Rime Crown
decennial.boss.evil_041.title: Frost Tyrant of the Glacier Hall
decennial.boss.evil_041.lore: The ice in the Glacier Hall is not water. It is the patience of Nemain, made solid.
decennial.boss.evil_040.name: Sanguinar the Last Eclipse
decennial.boss.evil_040.title: Star-Eater of the Observatory of the Void
decennial.boss.evil_040.lore: The stars over the Observatory of the Void go out one by one. Sanguinar is not hurrying; it has all night, and all the nights after.
decennial.boss.evil_039.name: Lamashu, Oathless
decennial.boss.evil_039.title: Fallen King of the Burnt Court
decennial.boss.evil_039.lore: Betrayed at his own coronation, Lamashu rules the Burnt Court as its fall: every pillar that cracks is a courtier who failed him.
decennial.boss.evil_038.name: Mauruth of the Green Wasting
decennial.boss.evil_038.title: Plague Lord of the Fever Ward
decennial.boss.evil_038.lore: Physician, then patient, then lord: Mauruth treats the Fever Ward the way a farmer treats a field.
decennial.boss.evil_037.name: Irongaunt the Undying Scholar
decennial.boss.evil_037.title: Lich of the Drowned Ossuary
decennial.boss.evil_037.lore: Bound to a phylactery sunk in the Drowned Ossuary, Irongaunt cannot be ended by blades alone: the grave itself answers for him.
decennial.boss.evil_036.name: Mordrake, Wyrm Beyond Death
decennial.boss.evil_036.title: Dracolich of the Hoard Under the Hill
decennial.boss.evil_036.lore: Mordrake died on its hoard and refused to leave it. The hoard of the Hoard Under the Hill has kept the dragon, and the dragon has kept the hoard.
decennial.boss.evil_035.name: Beholder
decennial.boss.evil_035.title: The Sphere of Many Eyes
decennial.boss.evil_035.lore: A sphere of hate with an eye for every kind of ruin. The Beholder has never been surprised, and does not intend to start.
decennial.boss.evil_034.name: Harrowgate, Rider of the Last Charge
decennial.boss.evil_034.title: Dread Knight of the Black Vanguard
decennial.boss.evil_034.lore: Once the finest blade of the Black Vanguard, Harrowgate broke his vow for a single night and has paid in iron for a thousand.
decennial.boss.evil_033.name: Thanatrix, Queen Under the Roots
decennial.boss.evil_033.title: Spider Queen of the Cobweb Throne
decennial.boss.evil_033.lore: Thanatrix wove a kingdom of silk under the roots, and each cocoon in the Cobweb Throne is a guest she is saving.
decennial.boss.evil_032.name: Dreadmoor, Host of the Red Dance
decennial.boss.evil_032.title: Vampire Lord of the Ballroom of Echoes
decennial.boss.evil_032.lore: Dreadmoor drinks slowly and forgets nothing. He remembers the name of everyone who ever bled in the Ballroom of Echoes.
decennial.boss.evil_031.name: Bloodmere the Black Omen
decennial.boss.evil_031.title: Doom Herald of the Hall of Omens
decennial.boss.evil_031.lore: Bloodmere brings news from the end of the world. It is a short announcement, and everyone in the Hall of Omens has heard it.
decennial.boss.evil_030.name: Urgoloth, Maw of the Rift
decennial.boss.evil_030.title: Abyssal Horror of the Black Trench
decennial.boss.evil_030.lore: Urgoloth is older than the dungeon, and the dungeon is older than anyone who walks it. the Black Trench is only where it chose to rise.
decennial.boss.evil_029.name: Moloch the Last Shadow
decennial.boss.evil_029.title: Shadow Reaper of the Rift of Rest
decennial.boss.evil_029.lore: Moloch arrives exactly on time, always. The fields of the Rift of Rest are well kept because of it.
decennial.boss.evil_028.name: Nahamah
decennial.boss.evil_028.title: Devil of Flame, Warden of the Second Gate
decennial.boss.evil_028.lore: Nahamah burns the roots of the Tree to keep warm, and they grow back black so that she may burn them again. The second gate is the hottest room in the Underworld.
decennial.boss.evil_027.name: Haldrex the Ticking Sovereign
decennial.boss.evil_027.title: Clockwork Tyrant of the Great Gantry
decennial.boss.evil_027.lore: Haldrex counts the seconds until you stop. It has been counting since before the vault of the Great Gantry had a roof.
decennial.boss.evil_026.name: Kharzul the Mire Sovereign
decennial.boss.evil_026.title: Rot Wyrm of the Black Mere
decennial.boss.evil_026.lore: Kharzul sleeps in the black water of the Black Mere with only her eyes above the mud. They never close.
decennial.boss.evil_025.name: Jorvane, Lord of the Burning Clause
decennial.boss.evil_025.title: Archdevil of the Ninth Pit
decennial.boss.evil_025.lore: Jorvane never lies; that is the horror of it. Every word he gave in the Ninth Pit is binding, and every one is kept to the letter.
decennial.boss.evil_024.name: Wraithmere the Grey Lady
decennial.boss.evil_024.title: Banshee Matriarch of the Weeping Court
decennial.boss.evil_024.lore: When Wraithmere wails in the Weeping Court, someone in the world dies. She has never once been wrong.
decennial.boss.evil_023.name: Strahd von Zarovich
decennial.boss.evil_023.title: The Devil of Barovia
decennial.boss.evil_023.lore: Strahd rules his ballroom the way he rules the mist: completely, and forever. The Devil of Barovia has outlived every family that ever feared him, and means to outlive yours.
decennial.boss.evil_022.name: Nocturne the Sleepless Ruler
decennial.boss.evil_022.title: Eye Tyrant of the Dream Vault
decennial.boss.evil_022.lore: Nocturne has never blinked. Nothing in the Dream Vault has been unobserved since the day it woke.
decennial.boss.evil_021.name: Lilithra the Other You
decennial.boss.evil_021.title: Mirror Duke of the Hall of Mirrors
decennial.boss.evil_021.lore: Lilithra has been in every mirror of the Hall of Mirrors for longer than the mirrors have been glass.
decennial.boss.evil_020.name: Pazuron the Salt Throne
decennial.boss.evil_020.title: Drowned Leviathan of the Sunken Nave
decennial.boss.evil_020.lore: Ships once sailed over the Sunken Nave. Pazuron remembers each one by the sound it made when it broke.
decennial.boss.evil_019.name: Corvane the Hooded Herald
decennial.boss.evil_019.title: Cult Prophet of the Hidden Chapter
decennial.boss.evil_019.lore: Corvane read the one book the Hidden Chapter was built to hide, and has been reading aloud ever since.
decennial.boss.evil_018.name: Nergalis, Prince of the Howling Rift
decennial.boss.evil_018.title: Demon Lord of the Howling Rift
decennial.boss.evil_018.lore: Nergalis does not scheme. Schemes are for devils. He walks out of the Howling Rift and everything in front of him is on fire.
decennial.boss.evil_017.name: Ungoliar the Thought-Eater
decennial.boss.evil_017.title: Mind Flayer of the Hive of Minds
decennial.boss.evil_017.lore: Ungoliar does not speak. It does not need to. The thralls of the Hive of Minds already say what it thinks, and mean it.
decennial.boss.evil_016.name: Venomhart, Smith of Endings
decennial.boss.evil_016.title: Forge Tyrant of the Magma Forge
decennial.boss.evil_016.lore: Venomhart forges one blade a century, and it is never for sale. the Magma Forge is lit by the discarded ones.
decennial.boss.evil_015.name: Zerathul, Rider of the Last Charge
decennial.boss.evil_015.title: Dread Knight of the Fallen March
decennial.boss.evil_015.lore: Zerathul swore to hold the Fallen March until relieved. Nobody came, and he has kept the oath ever since, in the dark.
decennial.boss.evil_014.name: Walgner
decennial.boss.evil_014.title: Devil of Blood, Warden of the First Gate
decennial.boss.evil_014.lore: Walgner drinks what he is given. The first gate of the Underworld Root opened for him, and the first thing he did was ask whose blood was nearest.
decennial.boss.evil_013.name: Ravenholt of the White Silence
decennial.boss.evil_013.title: Frost Tyrant of the Frozen Keep
decennial.boss.evil_013.lore: Ravenholt has ruled the Frozen Keep through ten thousand winters. Spring is a rumour he does not allow.
decennial.boss.evil_012.name: Fyrnoth the Slow Harvest
decennial.boss.evil_012.title: Plague Lord of the Weeping Fen
decennial.boss.evil_012.lore: Fyrnoth rings the bell of the Weeping Fen once for every soul the sickness takes. It has not stopped ringing in four hundred years.
decennial.boss.evil_011.name: Fenrisca, Weaver of Fates
decennial.boss.evil_011.title: Spider Queen of the Silk Warrens
decennial.boss.evil_011.lore: Every thread in the Silk Warrens leads to Fenrisca. She feels you the moment you touch one, and waits.
decennial.boss.evil_010.name: Cindralor the Velvet Fang
decennial.boss.evil_010.title: Vampire Lord of the Crimson Court
decennial.boss.evil_010.lore: Cindralor gives a ball every century. the Crimson Court is the only hall in the world where the dancers never tire and the guests never leave.
decennial.boss.evil_009.name: Ichorane, Mistress of the Last Dance
decennial.boss.evil_009.title: Sin Duchess of the Gilded Salon
decennial.boss.evil_009.lore: Ichorane grants one wish to every guest of the Gilded Salon. The price is always the second wish, and then the third.
decennial.boss.evil_008.name: Ashkendor, Who Wears the Dead
decennial.boss.evil_008.title: Wraith King of the Mourning Fields
decennial.boss.evil_008.lore: Ashkendor is what remains when a king is mourned by too many: a crown of grief that walks the Mourning Fields and takes what it touches.
decennial.boss.evil_007.name: Phlegethor, Champion of the Sand
decennial.boss.evil_007.title: Gladiator Revenant of the Bloodied Sand
decennial.boss.evil_007.lore: Phlegethor won a thousand bouts and died on the thousand and first. The crowd of the Bloodied Sand never went home.
decennial.boss.evil_006.name: Necrovane of the Chained Pack
decennial.boss.evil_006.title: Hell Warden of the Ember Kennels
decennial.boss.evil_006.lore: Necrovane was given the keys to the Ember Kennels for a single night, and has not given them back in ten thousand.
decennial.boss.evil_005.name: Grimvaul the Patient Heir
decennial.boss.evil_005.title: Necromancer of the Rotted Academy
decennial.boss.evil_005.lore: Grimvaul was an apprentice who found that the dead take instruction better than the living, and opened a school in the Rotted Academy.
decennial.boss.evil_004.name: Alecto of the Boiling Hollow
decennial.boss.evil_004.title: Hag of the Hollow Oak
decennial.boss.evil_004.lore: Alecto asks one question of every traveller to the Hollow Oak. The wrong answer is a frog; the right answer is worse.
decennial.boss.evil_003.name: Belisarra the Third Cut
decennial.boss.evil_003.title: Sanguine Prophet of the Red Altar
decennial.boss.evil_003.lore: Belisarra preaches in the Red Altar that every death is a debt paid forward, and collects the interest in person.
decennial.boss.evil_002.name: Quillothe the Hollow Crown
decennial.boss.evil_002.title: Fallen King of the Shattered Hall
decennial.boss.evil_002.lore: Quillothe lost a kingdom, then a name, then everything but the crown; the throne of the Shattered Hall still keeps his seat warm.
decennial.boss.evil_001.name: Jezreth the Undying Scholar
decennial.boss.evil_001.title: Lich of the Weeping Graves
decennial.boss.evil_001.lore: Jezreth traded breath for patience and has counted the dead of the Weeping Graves ever since; every name he reads aloud stands up.
decennial.boss.holy_001.name: Solara of the First Light
decennial.boss.holy_001.title: Paladin of the Dawn Bastion
decennial.boss.holy_001.lore: Solara swore at sunrise to guard the Dawn Bastion until the last darkness was gone. It has not yet been gone.
decennial.boss.holy_002.name: Thecla, High Priest of the Zenith
decennial.boss.holy_002.title: Sun Priest of the Zenith Temple
decennial.boss.holy_002.lore: Thecla opens the roof of the Zenith Temple at noon so the sun may look upon the faithful. It has not yet closed it.
decennial.boss.holy_003.name: Gertrude of the Garden Gate
decennial.boss.holy_003.title: Cherub Sentinel of the Terrace Gate
decennial.boss.holy_003.lore: Gertrude is small, quick and entirely serious. the Terrace Gate has never been entered without its leave.
decennial.boss.holy_004.name: Kentigern of the Rune-Carved Brow
decennial.boss.holy_004.title: Guardian Golem of the Gate Court
decennial.boss.holy_004.lore: Kentigern was told to guard the Gate Court and has since forgotten what it is guarding. That has not changed its aim.
decennial.boss.holy_005.name: Ysolde, Reader of Hearts
decennial.boss.holy_005.title: Inquisitor of the Truth Chamber
decennial.boss.holy_005.lore: Ysolde asks a single question of every traveller to the Truth Chamber, and listens to what the answer does not say.
decennial.boss.holy_006.name: Aldric, Who Forgave the Fire
decennial.boss.holy_006.title: Martyr of the Kneeling Nave
decennial.boss.holy_006.lore: Aldric was burned in the Kneeling Nave and forgave everyone in the crowd. The flames are still the best-tended in the world.
decennial.boss.holy_007.name: Kyrielle the Moonlit Elder
decennial.boss.holy_007.title: Unicorn Elder of the Silver Glade
decennial.boss.holy_007.lore: Kyrielle has walked the Silver Glade since before the first road. She does not want you to leave, and does not want you to stay.
decennial.boss.holy_008.name: Rhiannon, Who Holds the Drowned Door
decennial.boss.holy_008.title: Tide Warden of the Pearl Gate
decennial.boss.holy_008.lore: The god of the Pearl Gate sank with its temple. Rhiannon stayed, and has kept the lamps lit under the water.
decennial.boss.holy_009.name: Justitia the Pale Lamp
decennial.boss.holy_009.title: Moon Priestess of the Moon Pool
decennial.boss.holy_009.lore: Justitia lights no lamps in the Moon Pool. The moon is enough, and she sees by it better than you do.
decennial.boss.holy_010.name: Faelumine, Queen of Thorn and Bloom
decennial.boss.holy_010.title: Verdant Archon of the Hanging Terraces
decennial.boss.holy_010.lore: Everything in the Hanging Terraces grows because Faelumine wills it so. She has not yet decided whether you are a flower or a weed.
decennial.boss.holy_011.name: Zenobia, Who Chooses the Fallen
decennial.boss.holy_011.title: Sky Knight of the Cloud Road
decennial.boss.holy_011.lore: Zenobia rides the wind over the Cloud Road and chooses who will fall. She has never been asked to choose twice.
decennial.boss.holy_012.name: Katharine the Bright Spear-Hand
decennial.boss.holy_012.title: Commander of the Vanguard Court
decennial.boss.holy_012.lore: Katharine commands a host that is no longer there. the Vanguard Court still marches to his orders, in perfect silence.
decennial.boss.holy_013.name: Eirene, Who Guards the High Roost
decennial.boss.holy_013.title: Griffon Lord of the High Roost
decennial.boss.holy_013.lore: The griffon lord of the High Roost has the body of a lion and the temper of the sky. Eirene is both.
decennial.boss.holy_014.name: Honorius the Spectrum Keeper
decennial.boss.holy_014.title: Prism Sage of the Prism Gallery
decennial.boss.holy_014.lore: Honorius lectures on light in the Prism Gallery. The demonstrations are what you are fighting.
decennial.boss.holy_015.name: Prudentia of the Quiet Forge
decennial.boss.holy_015.title: Forge Saint of the Dawn-Forge
decennial.boss.holy_015.lore: Prudentia forges the swords of the faithful in the Dawn-Forge, one a year, with a prayer for each blow.
decennial.boss.holy_016.name: Concordia, Messenger of the Throne
decennial.boss.holy_016.title: Herald of the Gate of Trumpets
decennial.boss.holy_016.lore: Concordia carries a message that is not for you. The difficulty is that you are in the way.
decennial.boss.holy_017.name: Rosalind the Walking Monument
decennial.boss.holy_017.title: Colossus of the Hall of Monuments
decennial.boss.holy_017.lore: Rosalind stood as a statue in the Hall of Monuments for a thousand years before it was needed. It woke with considerable patience.
decennial.boss.holy_018.name: Ignatia the Prism Unbroken
decennial.boss.holy_018.title: Crystal Warden of the Singing Geode
decennial.boss.holy_018.lore: Ignatia does not move often. When the Singing Geode rings, it is because Ignatia has shifted its weight.
decennial.boss.holy_019.name: Heliodor, Scribe of the Unwritten
decennial.boss.holy_019.title: Archivist of the Bright Archive
decennial.boss.holy_019.lore: Heliodor has written down everything that ever happened in the Bright Archive, including the part that is about to happen to you.
decennial.boss.holy_020.name: Wenceslas of the Nine Constellations
decennial.boss.holy_020.title: Star Oracle of the Star Observatory
decennial.boss.holy_020.lore: Wenceslas reads the stars of the Star Observatory the way others read a letter. Most of what she sees she would rather not repeat.
decennial.boss.holy_021.name: Eostre, Magistrate of the Court
decennial.boss.holy_021.title: Archon of the Court of Scales
decennial.boss.holy_021.lore: Eostre holds court in the Court of Scales. Every sentence is final, and every one of them is fair, which is the difficulty.
decennial.boss.holy_022.name: Amaranth of the Pale Watch
decennial.boss.holy_022.title: Frost Sentinel of the Winter Gate
decennial.boss.holy_022.lore: Amaranth stood guard on the Winter Gate through a winter that never ended. The ice has grown into the armour.
decennial.boss.holy_023.name: Benedicta of the Ashen Dawn
decennial.boss.holy_023.title: Phoenix Avatar of the Ashen Terrace
decennial.boss.holy_023.lore: Benedicta burns down to ash every night and rises at dawn. the Ashen Terrace has learned to build around the pyre.
decennial.boss.holy_024.name: Beatrix the Patient Pendulum
decennial.boss.holy_024.title: Keeper of Hours of the Hour-Vault
decennial.boss.holy_024.lore: Beatrix keeps the hours of the Hour-Vault. It will keep yours, if you stand still long enough.
decennial.boss.holy_025.name: Quirin of the Unbroken Law
decennial.boss.holy_025.title: Dragon of Order of the Golden Aerie
decennial.boss.holy_025.lore: Quirin sits on a hoard of laws, not coins. the Golden Aerie is the only treasure in the world that argues back.
decennial.boss.holy_026.name: Radegund, Who Rides the Gale
decennial.boss.holy_026.title: Thunder Seraph of the Storm Spire
decennial.boss.holy_026.lore: Thunder is the sound of Radegund arriving. the Storm Spire has been without a quiet moment since.
decennial.boss.holy_027.name: Merewyn the Worn Giant
decennial.boss.holy_027.title: Colossus of the Titan's Terrace
decennial.boss.holy_027.lore: The monument of the Titan's Terrace was a god once. Merewyn remembers, and is not unhappy about the change.
decennial.boss.holy_028.name: Declan the Lens of Dawn
decennial.boss.holy_028.title: Star Oracle of the Orrery Hall
decennial.boss.holy_028.lore: Every constellation is a sentence. Declan is the last who can still parse the grammar.
decennial.boss.holy_029.name: Eadgyth, Sworn at Sunrise
decennial.boss.holy_029.title: Paladin of the Sunrise Chapel
decennial.boss.holy_029.lore: No blade has found the gap in the armour of Eadgyth. Few have found the kindness under it, which is stranger.
decennial.boss.holy_030.name: Lorelei, Bearer of the Scales
decennial.boss.holy_030.title: Judgement Angel of the Court of Last Appeal
decennial.boss.holy_030.lore: Lorelei reads the book of the Court of Last Appeal aloud before every fight. Few interrupt, and fewer are interrupted.
decennial.boss.holy_031.name: Brigantia of the Shining Host
decennial.boss.holy_031.title: Archangel of the Court of Wings
decennial.boss.holy_031.lore: Brigantia descended from the the Court of Wings to deal with the dungeon, and finds it more troublesome than expected.
decennial.boss.holy_032.name: Nikandra, Who Forgave the Fire
decennial.boss.holy_032.title: Martyr of the Chapel of Embers
decennial.boss.holy_032.lore: The relics of the Chapel of Embers work miracles. Nikandra is the miracle they were taken from.
decennial.boss.holy_033.name: Dorothea of the Rune-Carved Brow
decennial.boss.holy_033.title: Guardian Golem of the Stone Vestibule
decennial.boss.holy_033.lore: Rune by rune, the stone brow of Dorothea is worn smooth. It still remembers every command.
decennial.boss.holy_034.name: Genevieve, Wings of the Morning
decennial.boss.holy_034.title: Phoenix Avatar of the Dawn Pyre
decennial.boss.holy_034.lore: It is not a bird. It is the memory of a fire that refused to go out.
decennial.boss.holy_035.name: Cynewulf the Cold Benediction
decennial.boss.holy_035.title: Platinum Wyrm of the Starlit Vault
decennial.boss.holy_035.lore: Cynewulf is the oldest thing in the Starlit Vault and the gentlest. It is also, as it will politely point out, the strongest.
decennial.boss.holy_036.name: Sariel the Gold Judge
decennial.boss.holy_036.title: Dragon of Order of the Roost of Justice
decennial.boss.holy_036.lore: A dragon of order judges by weight. Sariel has weighed every traveller to the Roost of Justice, and some are heavier than others.
decennial.boss.holy_037.name: Olwen, Who Watches the Wall
decennial.boss.holy_037.title: Cherub Sentinel of the Cloud Orchard
decennial.boss.holy_037.lore: Do not mistake the size of Olwen for mercy. The arrows of the Cloud Orchard have never missed.
decennial.boss.holy_038.name: Sanctiel the Briar Crowned
decennial.boss.holy_038.title: Verdant Archon of the Bloom Court
decennial.boss.holy_038.lore: Sanctiel plants one seed for every hero who falls in the Bloom Court. The garden is very large.
decennial.boss.holy_039.name: Leofric, Keeper of the First Star
decennial.boss.holy_039.title: Platinum Wyrm of the Platinum Peak
decennial.boss.holy_039.lore: Its scales are the colour of a star at dawn, and as hard as the dawn has ever been.
decennial.boss.holy_040.name: Mechtild, Who Asks Only Once
decennial.boss.holy_040.title: Inquisitor of the Seal Court
decennial.boss.holy_040.lore: The seals of the Seal Court are his: each one a verdict, each one final.
decennial.boss.holy_041.name: Oswin the Even Hand
decennial.boss.holy_041.title: Archon of the Hall of Verdicts
decennial.boss.holy_041.lore: The scales of the Hall of Verdicts have never tipped. Oswin has made certain that they never would.
decennial.boss.holy_042.name: Beorhtric the Prism Unbroken
decennial.boss.holy_042.title: Crystal Warden of the Amethyst Nave
decennial.boss.holy_042.lore: Each facet of Beorhtric shows a different you. All of them are afraid.
decennial.boss.holy_043.name: Temperantia, Who Draws the Moon
decennial.boss.holy_043.title: Moon Priestess of the Silver Glade
decennial.boss.holy_043.lore: At the full moon the water of the Silver Glade stands up. Temperantia has asked it to hold its tongue.
decennial.boss.holy_044.name: Saoirse, Messenger of the Throne
decennial.boss.holy_044.title: Herald of the Hall of Messengers
decennial.boss.holy_044.lore: He announces himself with a horn. After that there is not much of a conversation.
decennial.boss.holy_045.name: Iduna, Voice of the Furnace
decennial.boss.holy_045.title: Seraph of the Throne of Fire
decennial.boss.holy_045.lore: Iduna sings a single note. the Throne of Fire has been standing inside that note for longer than it has had walls.
decennial.boss.holy_046.name: Evangeline the Tempest Crowned
decennial.boss.holy_046.title: Thunder Seraph of the Thunder Terrace
decennial.boss.holy_046.lore: Where Evangeline walks, the lightning rods of the Thunder Terrace sing in unison.
decennial.boss.holy_047.name: Wulfstan the Sword Unsheathed
decennial.boss.holy_047.title: Archangel of the Upper Ramparts
decennial.boss.holy_047.lore: The host of the Upper Ramparts sings, and Wulfstan is the first voice. When it falls silent, so does the sky.
decennial.boss.holy_048.name: Valkyne, Lens-Bearer of the Hall
decennial.boss.holy_048.title: Prism Sage of the Spectral Hall
decennial.boss.holy_048.lore: A single white ray goes into the prism of the Spectral Hall; seven come out. Valkyne is responsible for all of them.
decennial.boss.holy_049.name: Uriel the Sea-Crowned
decennial.boss.holy_049.title: Tide Warden of the Coral Hall
decennial.boss.holy_049.lore: Each tide of the Coral Hall is a prayer. Uriel has not missed one in a thousand years.
decennial.boss.holy_050.name: Aurora, Voice of the Furnace
decennial.boss.holy_050.title: Seraph of the Burning Court
decennial.boss.holy_050.lore: Six wings: two to cover the face, two to cover the feet, two to fly. Aurora has been caught using none of them.
decennial.boss.holy_051.name: Aelfwyn the Radiant Hand
decennial.boss.holy_051.title: Sun Priest of the Golden Stair
decennial.boss.holy_051.lore: The priest of the Golden Stair keeps no secrets. The sun sees all, and he sees what the sun sees.
decennial.boss.holy_052.name: Raphaela, Warden of the Last Minute
decennial.boss.holy_052.title: Keeper of Hours of the Chamber of Pendulums
decennial.boss.holy_052.lore: In the Chamber of Pendulums no hour is wasted, because Raphaela has already spent them all.
decennial.boss.holy_053.name: Remiel, Who Tempers the Dawn
decennial.boss.holy_053.title: Forge Saint of the Blessed Foundry
decennial.boss.holy_053.lore: Fire is a hymn to Remiel. The anvil of the Blessed Foundry is the altar, and the hammer is how she says amen.
decennial.boss.holy_054.name: Petronel, Sentinel of the White Bastion
decennial.boss.holy_054.title: Frost Sentinel of the White Bastion
decennial.boss.holy_054.lore: It remembers warmth as a rumour told by older ice. It guards the White Bastion for the sake of the rumour.
decennial.boss.holy_055.name: The Solar
decennial.boss.holy_055.title: Slayer with the Bow
decennial.boss.holy_055.lore: The Solar is the strongest of the angels, a bow of pure light in a hand that has never shaken. He is the judgement of the heavens, and you are the case.
decennial.boss.holy_056.name: Perpetua, Knight of the Cloud Road
decennial.boss.holy_056.title: Sky Knight of the Upper Bridge
decennial.boss.holy_056.lore: The lance of Perpetua is longer than it looks. the Upper Bridge is wider than it seems. Both are deceptions of the sky.
decennial.boss.holy_057.name: Zadkiel the Moonlit Elder
decennial.boss.holy_057.title: Unicorn Elder of the Last Spring
decennial.boss.holy_057.lore: The horn of Zadkiel heals what it touches. It also, with equal ease, does not.
decennial.boss.holy_058.name: Swithun, Lord of the Vanguard
decennial.boss.holy_058.title: Commander of the Silver Barracks
decennial.boss.holy_058.lore: Never once has the banner of Swithun fallen in the Silver Barracks. Never once has he said it would not.
decennial.boss.holy_059.name: Seraphine the Sword of the Verdict
decennial.boss.holy_059.title: Judgement Angel of the Judgment Floor
decennial.boss.holy_059.lore: To be judged by Seraphine is no punishment. To be found wanting is.
decennial.boss.holy_060.name: Nicasius, Who Guards the High Roost
decennial.boss.holy_060.title: Griffon Lord of the Cloud Meadow
decennial.boss.holy_060.lore: He nests above the Cloud Meadow and lets no one cross his shadow. He is correct to.
decennial.boss.holy_061.name: Luminara of the Gilded Index
decennial.boss.holy_061.title: Archivist of the Shelf of Names
decennial.boss.holy_061.lore: The shelves of the Shelf of Names hold one book per soul. Luminara knows your page, and the last sentence.
decennial.boss.holy_062.name: Cuthbert the Even Hand
decennial.boss.holy_062.title: Archon of the Gilded Tribunal
decennial.boss.holy_062.lore: There is no appeal to Cuthbert. There is only the appeal he is already making on your behalf, which you will not like.
decennial.boss.holy_063.name: Elowen, Herald of the Hour
decennial.boss.holy_063.title: Archangel of the Burning Terrace
decennial.boss.holy_063.lore: Fear of Elowen is the beginning of wisdom. Most never get further than the beginning.
decennial.boss.holy_064.name: Auriel, Mother of the Glade
decennial.boss.holy_064.title: Unicorn Elder of the Moonlit Meadow
decennial.boss.holy_064.lore: The glade of the Moonlit Meadow is hers, and it is quiet in the way a held breath is quiet.
decennial.boss.holy_065.name: Aletheia, Lord of the Vanguard
decennial.boss.holy_065.title: Commander of the Banner Hall
decennial.boss.holy_065.lore: He fights as he drilled: calmly, in order, and without the possibility of a retreat.
decennial.boss.holy_066.name: Lucianne, Warden of Ringing Stone
decennial.boss.holy_066.title: Crystal Warden of the Facet Hall
decennial.boss.holy_066.lore: It guards the Facet Hall because the crystals asked, in a language that is mostly vibration.
decennial.boss.holy_067.name: Ondine, Who Guards the Golden Gate
decennial.boss.holy_067.title: Dragon of Order of the Law-Peak
decennial.boss.holy_067.lore: The breath of Ondine is bright and clean. It is not an attack. It is a verdict.
decennial.boss.holy_068.name: Eithne the Pale Majesty
decennial.boss.holy_068.title: Platinum Wyrm of the Hall of Frozen Light
decennial.boss.holy_068.lore: Eithne asks one question of the dying: whether they would do it again. The answer decides everything.
decennial.boss.holy_069.name: Ninian, Keeper of Stars Unborn
decennial.boss.holy_069.title: Star Oracle of the Constellation Stair
decennial.boss.holy_069.lore: She has already seen how this fight ends. She is, regardless, very polite about it.
decennial.boss.holy_070.name: Haniel the Storm's Right Hand
decennial.boss.holy_070.title: Thunder Seraph of the Gale Court
decennial.boss.holy_070.lore: She does not choose her targets. The storm does, and Haniel agrees with it.
decennial.boss.holy_071.name: Fiacre the Worn Giant
decennial.boss.holy_071.title: Colossus of the Great Plinth
decennial.boss.holy_071.lore: The ground shakes with every step of Fiacre, and the Great Plinth has stopped noticing.
decennial.boss.holy_072.name: Camael the Bright Proclamation
decennial.boss.holy_072.title: Herald of the High Veranda
decennial.boss.holy_072.lore: the High Veranda has been waiting for the herald, and Camael has been waiting for the hall to be ready.
decennial.boss.holy_073.name: Selenia, Who Winds the Day
decennial.boss.holy_073.title: Keeper of Hours of the Gilded Dial
decennial.boss.holy_073.lore: Each pendulum swing is a verdict. The Keeper counts them in a very quiet voice.
decennial.boss.holy_074.name: Dawnwyn the Unmoved Judge
decennial.boss.holy_074.title: Judgement Angel of the Sentencing Terrace
decennial.boss.holy_074.lore: Her scales hold no bias, and that is the whole of her terror.
decennial.boss.holy_075.name: Titania, King of the Cloud Meadow
decennial.boss.holy_075.title: Griffon Lord of the Golden Eyrie
decennial.boss.holy_075.lore: A single feather of Titania is worth a kingdom, and he is aware of the market.
decennial.boss.holy_076.name: Gallio of the Bright Ledger
decennial.boss.holy_076.title: Archivist of the Ledger Hall
decennial.boss.holy_076.lore: Every footnote in the Ledger Hall is a small act of mercy. Gallio added all of them.
decennial.boss.holy_077.name: The Tarrasque
decennial.boss.holy_077.title: The Last Sleeper
decennial.boss.holy_077.lore: The Last Sleeper wakes only when the world is already ending. The Tarrasque cannot be reasoned with, because it was never listening.
decennial.boss.holy_078.name: Lucerna, Voice of the Furnace
decennial.boss.holy_078.title: Seraph of the Hall of Flames
decennial.boss.holy_078.lore: To look at Lucerna is to understand why the old texts say to look away.
decennial.boss.holy_079.name: Isidora of the Last Ember
decennial.boss.holy_079.title: Phoenix Avatar of the Sunward Roost
decennial.boss.holy_079.lore: Kill Isidora once, and it will thank you. Kill it twice, and it will remember.
decennial.boss.holy_080.name: Fidelis of the Shining Host
decennial.boss.holy_080.title: Archangel of the High Colonnade
decennial.boss.holy_080.lore: Fidelis descended from the the High Colonnade to deal with the dungeon, and finds it more troublesome than expected.
decennial.boss.holy_081.name: Magnus the Tempest Crowned
decennial.boss.holy_081.title: Thunder Seraph of the High Anvil
decennial.boss.holy_081.lore: Thunder is the sound of Magnus arriving. the High Anvil has been without a quiet moment since.
decennial.boss.holy_082.name: Cordelia the Even Tick
decennial.boss.holy_082.title: Keeper of Hours of the Sandglass Hall
decennial.boss.holy_082.lore: Cordelia keeps the hours of the Sandglass Hall. It will keep yours, if you stand still long enough.
decennial.boss.holy_083.name: Jophiel, Keeper of the First Star
decennial.boss.holy_083.title: Platinum Wyrm of the Crystal Aerie
decennial.boss.holy_083.lore: Jophiel is the oldest thing in the Crystal Aerie and the gentlest. It is also, as it will politely point out, the strongest.
decennial.boss.holy_084.name: Innocent the Law Made Bright
decennial.boss.holy_084.title: Archon of the Law-Stair
decennial.boss.holy_084.lore: Innocent holds court in the Law-Stair. Every sentence is final, and every one of them is fair, which is the difficulty.
decennial.boss.holy_085.name: Hildegard the Burning One
decennial.boss.holy_085.title: Seraph of the Sunward Spire
decennial.boss.holy_085.lore: Hildegard sings a single note. the Sunward Spire has been standing inside that note for longer than it has had walls.
decennial.boss.holy_086.name: Remigius the Sun-Scaled
decennial.boss.holy_086.title: Dragon of Order of the Sun Cavern
decennial.boss.holy_086.lore: Remigius sits on a hoard of laws, not coins. the Sun Cavern is the only treasure in the world that argues back.
decennial.boss.holy_087.name: Fortitudo the Lens of Dawn
decennial.boss.holy_087.title: Star Oracle of the Dome of Maps
decennial.boss.holy_087.lore: Fortitudo reads the stars of the Dome of Maps the way others read a letter. Most of what she sees she would rather not repeat.
decennial.boss.holy_088.name: Elariel of the Last Ember
decennial.boss.holy_088.title: Phoenix Avatar of the Cinder Spire
decennial.boss.holy_088.lore: Elariel burns down to ash every night and rises at dawn. the Cinder Spire has learned to build around the pyre.
decennial.boss.holy_089.name: Fionnuala, Messenger of the Throne
decennial.boss.holy_089.title: Herald of the Stair of Words
decennial.boss.holy_089.lore: Fionnuala carries a message that is not for you. The difficulty is that you are in the way.
decennial.boss.holy_090.name: Bahamut
decennial.boss.holy_090.title: The Platinum Dragon
decennial.boss.holy_090.lore: The Platinum Dragon, king of the good dragons, descended from his mountain of clouds to measure the heroes of the dungeon. He will be fair. He will not be gentle.
decennial.boss.holy_091.name: Stellara of the Open Book
decennial.boss.holy_091.title: Judgement Angel of the Ledger of Light
decennial.boss.holy_091.lore: Stellara reads the book of the Ledger of Light aloud before every fight. Few interrupt, and fewer are interrupted.
decennial.boss.holy_092.name: Baldric the Sword Unsheathed
decennial.boss.holy_092.title: Archangel of the Gate of Trumpets
decennial.boss.holy_092.lore: The host of the Gate of Trumpets sings, and Baldric is the first voice. When it falls silent, so does the sky.
decennial.boss.holy_093.name: Taliesin, Who Sings Without Pause
decennial.boss.holy_093.title: Seraph of the Altar of Hours
decennial.boss.holy_093.lore: Six wings: two to cover the face, two to cover the feet, two to fly. Taliesin has been caught using none of them.
decennial.boss.holy_094.name: Alfreda, Wyrm of Even Scales
decennial.boss.holy_094.title: Dragon of Order of the Gilded Eyrie
decennial.boss.holy_094.lore: A dragon of order judges by weight. Alfreda has weighed every traveller to the Gilded Eyrie, and some are heavier than others.
decennial.boss.holy_095.name: Gwenhwyfar the Pale Majesty
decennial.boss.holy_095.title: Platinum Wyrm of the Silver Cairn
decennial.boss.holy_095.lore: Its scales are the colour of a star at dawn, and as hard as the dawn has ever been.
decennial.boss.holy_096.name: Quintus the Sword of the Verdict
decennial.boss.holy_096.title: Judgement Angel of the Gold Assize
decennial.boss.holy_096.lore: To be judged by Quintus is no punishment. To be found wanting is.
decennial.boss.holy_097.name: Dunstan of the Shining Host
decennial.boss.holy_097.title: Archangel of the Hall of Choirs
decennial.boss.holy_097.lore: Fear of Dunstan is the beginning of wisdom. Most never get further than the beginning.
decennial.boss.holy_098.name: Elyndra the Gold Judge
decennial.boss.holy_098.title: Dragon of Order of the High Cairn
decennial.boss.holy_098.lore: The breath of Elyndra is bright and clean. It is not an attack. It is a verdict.
decennial.boss.holy_099.name: Ciaran, Wyrm of the Silver Wind
decennial.boss.holy_099.title: Platinum Wyrm of the High Winter
decennial.boss.holy_099.lore: Ciaran asks one question of the dying: whether they would do it again. The answer decides everything.
decennial.boss.holy_100.name: Felicity of the Final Sentence
decennial.boss.holy_100.title: Judgement Angel of the Gate of Weighing
decennial.boss.holy_100.lore: Her scales hold no bias, and that is the whole of her terror.
decennial.arena.qliphoth_gate_1: The First Gate of the Underworld Root
decennial.arena.qliphoth_gate_2: The Second Gate of the Underworld Root
decennial.arena.qliphoth_gate_3: The Third Gate of the Underworld Root
decennial.arena.qliphoth_gate_4: The Fourth Gate of the Underworld Root
decennial.arena.qliphoth_gate_5: The Fifth Gate of the Underworld Root
decennial.arena.qliphoth_gate_6: The Sixth Gate of the Underworld Root
decennial.arena.qliphoth_gate_7: The Seventh Gate of the Underworld Root
decennial.lair.grave_hands: Hands claw up out of the graves!
decennial.lair.soul_fog: A fog of souls rolls over the floor. Leave it.
decennial.lair.bone_spikes: Bone spikes tear up the floor towards you!
decennial.lair.blood_rain: Blood rains from the roof. Step out of it.
decennial.lair.chain_pull: Chains lash out and drag everyone towards the boss!
decennial.lair.pillar_fall: A pillar groans and begins to fall. Get clear of its path!
decennial.lair.eye_beams: Eyes open in the dark and fire!
decennial.lair.plague_cloud: A plague cloud rises from the bog.
decennial.lair.abyss_maw: The floor splits open under someone. Run!
decennial.lair.black_sap: Black sap wells up round the roots. Do not stand in it.
decennial.lair.spore_burst: The spores burst, and the room swims!
decennial.lair.web_snare: Webs shoot out to snare you!
decennial.lair.steam_vents: Steam roars out of the vents!
decennial.lair.frost_nova: A killing frost spreads from the boss!
decennial.lair.void_collapse: The void collapses inward and pulls at you!
decennial.lair.tide_surge: A tide pours across the floor.
decennial.lair.holy_beams: Beams of holy light fall! Move!
decennial.lair.radiant_nova: A nova of radiance bursts from the boss!
decennial.lair.falling_stars: Stars fall around you. Watch the rings!
decennial.lair.judgment_rings: Rings of judgment spread across the floor!
decennial.lair.wind_gusts: A great wind sweeps the hall!
decennial.lair.sunburst: The sun gathers over someone. Leave the circle!
decennial.signature.phylactery_ward: Its phylactery renews a ward of soul-stuff every twenty seconds.
decennial.signature.grave_tithe: Every servant that dies feeds it a little ward.
decennial.signature.bone_aegis: Bone spurs turn a share of every blow against its attacker.
decennial.signature.stolen_light: It drinks the magicules of those who stand close.
decennial.signature.crown_of_ruin: After two and a half minutes the crown burns and it strikes harder.
decennial.signature.oathbreaker_charge: It vanishes and strikes from behind a random hero.
decennial.signature.dread_presence: Stay far away and it grows a ward and comes for you.
decennial.signature.hex_cauldron: A green miasma poisons everyone near it.
decennial.signature.sanguine_pact: While its brood lives, it takes a quarter less damage.
decennial.signature.sanguine_echo: A fifth of its blows land twice.
decennial.signature.infernal_contract: Every eighteen seconds the contract pulls the party in.
decennial.signature.frost_heart: Cold gnaws at everyone close to it.
decennial.signature.mirror_veil: Arrows and bolts are turned aside, and some turn back.
decennial.signature.radiant_ward: A ward of light closes round it every eighteen seconds.
decennial.signature.sacred_thorns: Holy thorns return a share of every blow.
decennial.signature.oath_of_dawn: It will not be fought from afar: a ward grows, and it comes.
decennial.signature.stone_covenant: While its guardians stand, it takes a fifth less damage.
decennial.signature.storm_charge: It arrives in a flash of lightning at a hero's side.
decennial.signature.star_pull: Every sixteen seconds the stars pull the party in.
decennial.signature.dragon_pride: After two minutes its pride flares and it strikes much harder.
decennial.signature.devil_union: After three minutes the union deepens and it strikes harder.
decennial.signature.root_tithe: The roots feed it a ward for every devil that falls.
decennial.signature.tide_ward: The tide closes a ward round it every sixteen seconds.
decennial.signature.void_craving: The void drinks the magicules of those who stand close.
decennial.signature.rime_shell: A rime of frost spreads from it and slows what it touches.
decennial.signature.ember_heart: Its heart is a forge: whatever stands close is scorched.
decennial.signature.thorn_mantle: A mantle of thorns bites those who strike it.
decennial.signature.gilded_ward: Its gold hardens into a ward every twenty-two seconds.
decennial.signature.judgement_echo: Its verdicts are given twice: some blows land again.
decennial.signature.web_of_fate: Venom hangs round it in a fine mist.
message.nusmp.mega.decennial.sealed: The doors of the hall seal behind you.
message.nusmp.mega.decennial.unsealed: The seal of the hall breaks.
message.nusmp.mega.decennial.gate_open: The great gate groans open. Take the Mana Core to the Gatekeeper.
message.nusmp.mega.decennial.reset: The hall resets. The fallen are forgotten, and the seals are restored.
message.nusmp.mega.decennial.element.tom: The tombstone cracks, and something answers.
message.nusmp.mega.decennial.element.roo: The root node bursts: lesser devils pour out!
message.nusmp.mega.decennial.band: Gate band %1$s of the Underworld Root.
